title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1115 | 声音灭火、机器人青蛙、河马宝宝
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🔊 墨西哥高中生发明了用声音灭火的装置，还拿了国际科学展金牌！
🐸 丹麦科学家用 3D 打印机做出一只会游泳的机器人小青蛙，不用电池、只靠光！
🦛 泰国动物园迎来一只小河马宝宝，还是网红河马 Moo Deng 的小侄子或小侄女！

📖 Word of the day: vortex（漩涡）

🎮 谜语：我看不见也摸不着，但你能听见我；我能吹灭蜡烛、扑灭小火苗。我是谁？答案：声音！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🔊 A high school student in Mexico built a machine that puts out fire with sound, and won a gold medal!
🐸 Scientists in Denmark printed a tiny robot frog that swims with light, no battery, no wires!
🦛 A baby pygmy hippo was born in Thailand, and it is Moo Deng's little niece or nephew!

📖 Word of the day: vortex

🎮 Riddle time: you cannot see me or touch me, but you can hear me. I can blow out a candle and put out a small fire. What am I? Sound!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. vortex（漩涡）
a spinning circle of air or water
例：The sound makes a vortex around the fire!（声音在火焰周围形成了一个漩涡！）

2. extinguish（扑灭）
to put out a fire
例：Sound can extinguish a small flame!（声音能扑灭小火苗！）

3. paddle（划水）
to move through water with your arms or legs
例：The little robot frog paddles across the water!（机器人小青蛙划水游过水面！）

4. calf（幼崽）
a baby cow, hippo, or other big animal
例：The baby hippo is a cute little calf!（小河马是一只可爱的幼崽！）
